description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Excise Notification to exempt Payment of Authorization fee Only for year of 2021 to 3 stars and 4 stars Classes Hotels and 5 stars Hotels etc.
categorisation: This gazette content pertains to a legal/regulatory matter concerning the Excise Ordinance. It specifically notifies about an order issued by the Minister of Finance that amends previous excise notifications to exempt authorization fees for certain hotel classes for the year 2021. The content focuses on regulatory changes and compliance requirements under existing legislation, fitting the definition of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes).
